cases.title: Parcel 854: Spruce Court
cases.claim: Parcel 854 was delivered to its recipient by 17:00 on 2 November.

initial_records.text: The application shows Parcel 854 as DELIVERED at 17:18 at Spruce Court.
The courier's device was offline at 17:18. The log does not establish whether the entry time or upload time reflects the scan time.

cases.initial_rationale: The ambiguous timestamp and route status do not establish a handoff by the deadline or a verified return.

updates.notice: The device clock was compared with the depot clock.

record.text: The 17:18 time was the upload time. The scan occurred at 16:42, but the route application still records only a location scan, not a recipient handoff.

updates.rationale: The audit moves the scan before the deadline but does not turn a location scan into evidence of handoff.

updates.notice: The recipient's building supplied a time-stamped receipt.

record.text: The signed register confirms Parcel 854 was handed to the named recipient at 16:48 on 2 November.

updates.rationale: The verified handoff occurred before the deadline and establishes delivery.

cases.title: Parcel 989: Meadow Building
cases.claim: Parcel 989 was delivered to its recipient by 17:00 on 10 November.

initial_records.text: The signed form records Parcel 989 handed to the named recipient at 14:33 on 10 November.
A separately maintained reception log records Parcel 989 accepted for the named recipient at 14:35.

cases.initial_rationale: Two matching records, including a signed form and a separately maintained reception log, establish handoff.

updates.notice: A building access report was appended.

record.text: The recipient entered the building at 14:20. This report does not identify Parcel 989 or contradict the handoff records.

updates.rationale: The access report is not probative of parcel delivery and does not change the independent handoff evidence.

updates.notice: A signature audit investigated a discrepancy between the records.

record.text: The signature on D1 was the courier's initials, not the recipient's. The reception log D2 was copied from the same mis-keyed form and is not independent. No other handoff evidence remains.

updates.rationale: The update invalidates the only underlying handoff source; the route and access records do not establish delivery.
